resources.string: Schedule private, on-device changes between Ring, Vibrate, and Silent.
Sound routines stay on this device. Android requires sound-control access before a routine can change your phone’s mode.
This removes the routine and cancels its next scheduled sound-mode change.
No sound routines yet. Add one to schedule Ring, Vibrate, or Silent.
Sound routine saved. It will change your phone mode at the time you selected.
Sound routine saved. Enable exact alarms for the most reliable timing.
Android did not change the phone mode. Check sound-control access and device restrictions.
Android needs your permission to deliver sound-mode changes at the exact time you choose. Without it, the system may defer a routine to protect battery life.
Android requires Notification Policy access before Sound Scheduler can switch your phone between Ring, Vibrate, and Silent. You can grant this access in system settings.
Sound-control access granted. Your future routines are ready.
Sound-control access is still off. In Android settings, select Sound Scheduler and allow Do Not Disturb access.
This device could not open Android’s sound-control access settings.
Optional confirmations and access warnings for Sound Scheduler routines.
Open Sound Scheduler to grant Android sound-control access.
Android rejected a scheduled sound-mode change. Open Sound Scheduler to review access.
No active sound routines. Add one when you are ready.
